cues: Enlarge the chest, and the pressure inside falls below the air outside, so air rushes in.
In inspiration the diaphragm contracts and flattens, and the external intercostal muscles lift the ribs up and out.
The lungs expand and about half a litre of air enters.
text: Breathing is pure physics. Enlarge the chest, and the pressure inside falls below the air outside, so air rushes in. In inspiration the diaphragm contracts and flattens, and the external intercostal muscles lift the ribs up and out. The lungs expand and about half a litre of air enters.
